svg.title: Public Sector Reseller Desk
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-06-public-sector-desk; chapter number: 11; chart type: org_architecture; title: Public Sector Reseller Desk; subtitle: Contract vehicles at the center, risk controls on every spoke; caption: Public sector resellers win on contract vehicles, not relationships, and pair schedule and marketplace roles with pricing and vendor-risk controls.; assumptions note: Roles are grouped from the Chapter Q11 mechanics; no practitioner stated a headcount, so none is given.; note: Sources: Clovity [fwAcWt5Q8oA @ 00:06:37]; GSA trainer [NVfgGOTkm4Q @ 00:02:34, 00:10:16]; How To Sell To & Win Federal Government Contracts [p3DsAuDE32c @ 00:12:11]; AWS Public Sector [F4gkR0s1Blw @ 00:02:10]; SecureOps with Ayden Connor [fOUGaSjlTBY @ 00:00:17]; Leegality [DeATzRK3azc @ 00:03:22].; center: role: Public sector reseller lead; headcount: Not stated in practitioner testimony; focus: Efficiency through contract vehicles; GSA schedule buys run about 10 days versus about 270 on the open market; spokes: role: GSA schedule manager; type: Contract vehicle; kpi: 0.75% IFF reported under the correct SIN; $25,000 annual sales minimum; avoid the 60%+ zero-sales group; role: AWS private offer lead; type: Marketplace channel; kpi: 1-60 month terms, up to 60 payments, naso or bid terms replacing commercial terms; role: Pricing analyst; type: Rate governance; kpi: No commercial quote below the GSA rate; CALC benchmarking; counteroffer reply by close of business tomorrow; role: Vendor risk controller; type: Payment and obligation control; kpi: Bank-detail changes confirmed on a known number; every cancellation window tracked after a 75 percent remaining-contract liability case
